items.description: RevenueCat is an app monetization platform for mobile and web apps: backend infrastructure for subscriptions, one-time purchases, virtual currencies, web purchases and ad revenue across Apple App Store, Google Play and web, plus no-code paywalls, A/B testing, analytics and integrations
Pricing: free to start; paid plan applies once an app earns over $2,500/month in tracked revenue, at 1% of tracked revenue; Enterprise custom pricing available
RevenueCat is not a payment processor — Apple, Google, Stripe and Paddle process payments; RevenueCat connects to them to manage access and revenue data

Supported stores/payment providers: Apple App Store, Google Play, Amazon Appstore, Roku, RevenueCat Web Billing, Stripe, Paddle; SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, Expo, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Cordova, Capacitor, Unity, Web, Roku
Documentation overview: what RevenueCat is, how it works, core architecture (docs hub)
Docs llms.txt — LLM-optimised version of the full RevenueCat documentation
RevenueCat MCP server setup for AI agent integration
Machine-readable product capabilities data (JSON, NDJSON, schema, capabilities index) and product knowledge manifest
SDK installation guides hub and quickstart for implementing a first purchase
Product feature marketing pages (infrastructure, paywalls, experiments, targeting, customer center, refund control, charts, virtual currency, funnels, reliability)
Technical docs pages on features and concepts (entitlements, products/offerings, paywalls, customer center, webhooks, metrics, web billing, redemption links, refunds)
